text:
Maya Shah: Hey team, just got an urgent ticket from ACME Corp — their token cost dashboard shows $0.00 for several EU subaccounts (org: 0xAC12). Screenshot: https://redwood.screenshots/acme-zero-eu.png
Samir Rao: thanks — when did this start for them? any deploys around the time?
Maya Shah: customer first noticed it yesterday afternoon (2026-03-15 ~13:30 UTC). We did the ledger-join rollout around 13:15 UTC (build: ledger-join@2026.03.15.4).
Jin Park: can you paste the query/dashboard widget config they are hitting? might be an aggregate/zero-fill issue.
Maya Shah: widget uses our token_costs view with this aggregation:```sql
SELECT org_id, subaccount_id, SUM(token_cost_cents)/100.0 AS cost_usd, SUM(tokens) AS tokens
FROM token_billing_agg
WHERE org_id = '0xAC12' AND region = 'eu' AND day BETWEEN '2026-03-12' AND '2026-03-15'
GROUP BY org_id, subaccount_id;```
Maya Shah: their UI shows cost_usd = 0.00 for subaccounts a, b, c but tokens > 0.
Samir Rao: hmm that suggests token_cost_cents is null or missing for those rows. If SUM ignores nulls we'd get null, but our frontend coalesces null->0 which shows $0.00.
Jin Park: quick check on prod:```sql
SELECT subaccount_id, SUM(token_cost_cents) AS total_cents, COUNT(*) AS rows
FROM token_billing_agg
WHERE org_id='0xAC12' AND region='eu' AND day='2026-03-14'
GROUP BY subaccount_id;```
Jin Park: returns subaccount a: total_cents = NULL, rows = 24; subaccount b: total_cents = NULL, rows = 24.
Samir Rao: that matches. Why would cost_cents be null? cost_cents is populated by the pricing join step (pricing_catalog LEFT JOIN token_usage). If the pricing_catalog key missing we drop cost.
Maya Shah: LedgerBot posted an automated deploy event at 13:15:``
LedgerBot: deployed ledger-join@2026.03.15.4 to prod (eu-west-1)
``
Mark Lee: I'm oncall — rolling the join logic back now to ledger-join@2026.03.14.9, will monitor.
Jin Park: quick grep in logs shows: `pricing_key IS NULL` for many eu records after the deploy — looks like the join predicate changed from `ON usage.price_key = pricing.key` to `ON usage.price_key = pricing.catalog_key` (typo). That would make the join fail silently.
Samir Rao: good catch. Fix: revert schema change or patch join to use correct column. Short-term mitigation: patch the dashboard query to `COALESCE(SUM(token_cost_cents), SUM(on_demand_price_cents))`? but that might mask real issue.
Maya Shah: customer is escalate-critical. I advised them we're investigating and will restore values or provide a CSV export. They want repro steps and ETA.
Mark Lee: rollback initiated at 13:38 UTC — confirm once metrics backfilled. I'll open an incident: RED-INC-987 and assign to eng-billing + eng-sre.
Jin Park: I'll prepare a backfill script:``
INSERT INTO token_billing_agg (org_id, subaccount_id, day, token_cost_cents, tokens)
SELECT u.org_id, u.subaccount_id, u.day, p.price_cents * u.tokens AS token_cost_cents, u.tokens
FROM raw_usage u JOIN pricing_catalog p ON u.price_key = p.key
WHERE u.day BETWEEN '2026-03-12' AND '2026-03-15' AND u.region='eu';
```
Maya Shah: thanks — I'll ping ACME with rollback + ETA for backfill (2-3 hours). Please add any temporary dashboard notes (banner) so other customers don't panic. :warning:
Samir Rao: added a temporary banner on the cost widget and set a stale-data flag for eu region.
LedgerBot: incident RED-INC-987 created and assigned to eng-billing.
Maya Shah: leaving this thread open, will update when ACME confirms.
Mark Lee: monitoring — if rollback doesn't fully restore, we'll force the backfill and run a consistency check across reserved/reserved-capacity tags.
Samir Rao: follow-ups: 1) patch join in CI to avoid similar typos 2) add a test for null pricing_key on ingest 3) improve dashboard to show 'data unavailable' rather than $0.00 when cost is null.
Maya Shah: noted. thanks team. :pray:
